name: Mamas & Papas Ocarro

clekListed.clekRow: Mamas & Papas Ocarro — Armadillo Flip/XT and Ocarro Maxi-Cosi car seat adapters (159925300)

_priceNote: Albee Baby $809.99 is the US list from its Ocarro listing (page returns 403 to automated fetch; reconfirm on load). GoodBuy $138.99 is an out-of-stock open-box unit. M&P UK price is £849 (GBP), not USD — listed for reference since M&P largely withdrew from the US market.

specs._dimsNote: Folds one-handed with the seat attached (either direction). 96 x 58 x 110 cm open; 37 x 58 x 76 cm folded.

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: from birth (lie-flat seat / carrycot) to 22 kg (48.5 lb)

safety.standards: EN 1888 (Mamas & Papas). Clek's official list attests the model was tested to the applicable ASTM stroller/car-seat standard for Liing use.
safety.notes: 5-point harness; reversible seat (parent- or world-facing); lie-flat recline; all-round suspension. Basket rated ~3 kg (6.6 lb) per Strollberry.

specs.foldType: one-hand compact fold with seat attached, free-standing
specs.tires: 8 in front / 11 in rear (19 cm / 27 cm) EVA foam-coated wheels; all-wheel suspension

notes: Full-size flagship all-terrain pram (~29.8 lb) — a do-everything stroller, not the ultralight city goal, but on Clek's list. US availability is thin since Mamas & Papas scaled back its US retail; Albee Baby still lists it (~$809.99). Liing attaches via the M&P Armadillo Flip/XT + Ocarro Maxi-Cosi adapter (adapter-159925300): the adapter enumerates Maxi-Cosi/Cybex/Joie footprints (Liing shares the Maxi-Cosi footprint) and Clek's authoritative list confirms Liing fits the Ocarro via this part.
